incidents.title: Fictional claim-link impersonation warning
incidents.summary: A fictional claim page is impersonating a project and asking visitors to connect wallets.
incidents.verificationNote: Two reviewers compared the report with a fictional official notice before publication.
advice: Avoid the claim link and check the project's official channels for updates.
